segments.title: Chương 16: 0016 【Phú bà không thiếu tiền】
segments.content:
Bian Guanyue was unwilling to reveal her own secrets, so she didn't pry into Chen Guiliang's story either.

She said nothing, her gaze cast out the car window.

The houses and farmlands on both sides of the road were all so drab and dusty, slowly receding as the vehicle moved forward.

Chen Guiliang understood that his current offensive had failed.

He wasn't disappointed.

What was the fun in winning on the first try?

Bian Guanyue kept silent, choosing to close her eyes and sleep, reverting to her cool and detached state from school.

Chen Guiliang thought to himself: On a road this bad, I'd be surprised if you could fall asleep.

Just a few minutes later, the road started to jolt again.

Bian Guanyue was tossed into the air and quickly opened her eyes to grab onto the metal bar. It seemed she had learned her lesson.

Chen Guiliang once again transformed into a tour guide, pointing to a small building on the roadside ahead. "That's my junior high classmate's house. His dad was in freight transport and bought a truck very early on. It was incredibly impressive back then, and he even got a home theater system. He used to bully me at first, but after I beat him into submission, we became friends, and he often invited me over to watch movies."

The first time Chen Guiliang watched a porn film was in that small building.

It was also there that he came to know of stars like Stephen Chow, Jackie Chan, and Andy Lau.

The memory was still fresh, unforgettable for a lifetime.

Bian Guanyue was being tossed about so much that faking sleep was impossible. Drawn in by Chen Guiliang's words, she subconsciously looked towards the four-story building.

"It hasn't been lived in for a long time, has it? The yard is full of weeds," Bian Guanyue said.

Chen Guiliang recounted, "His family was quite rich and got targeted. Under the guise of Spring Festival entertainment, they set up a gambling scheme to lure his dad in. He won at first, then lost, and the stakes kept getting higher. He lost the truck and even took out a high-interest loan. Just as they were arranging to sell the house, the family fell apart."

"Did they die?" Bian Guanyue asked, startled.

Chen Guiliang nodded. "His dad hanged himself, his mom drank pesticide. His grandparents died of rage. The incident caused such a stir that the police got involved. One of the schemers who lured him into gambling was caught, and the rest all fled."

Bian Guanyue asked, "What about your classmate himself?"

Chen Guiliang said, "He dropped out of school and went to Yangcheng to work. Somehow, he went down the wrong path, got locked up for armed robbery. He'll probably be in for a few more years."

Bian Guanyue muttered to herself: What kind of an upbringing is this?

Seeing that she was willing to talk again, Chen Guiliang asked, "Your school registration is in Rongcheng, right? You have to go back to Rongcheng for the college entrance exam?"

"Yeah," Bian Guanyue replied.

This reaction seemed to confirm that there really were family conflicts, and she wasn't willing to talk much about related topics.

Chen Guiliang began to reminisce about his childhood. "Speaking of Rongcheng, I remember a nursery rhyme from when I was little. I only remember two lines now: 'Mǎ ma dēng er flies down, the big sister from Rongcheng is coming back.' Do you know what Mǎ ma dēng er is?"

Bian Guanyue said, "A little girl's pigtails that stick straight up."

"Besides pigtails, it also refers to dragonflies," Chen Guiliang asked, "How do you say dragonfly in the Rongcheng dialect?"

Bian Guanyue must have also recalled her childhood, as a faint smile appeared on her face. "In Rongcheng, dragonflies are called dīng dīng māo er. It's the same as here in Longdu, dīng dīng māo er means both dragonfly and a little girl's pigtails."

The breakthrough was made again. As Chen Guiliang repeatedly probed and guided, Bian Guanyue started to actively share some amusing stories from her childhood.

Before they knew it, they had reached their destination: Longdu City Railway Station.

Bian Guanyue said in pleasant surprise, "I remember the railway station. When I was little and came back from Rongcheng, we'd take the train and get off here first. I don't know which year it was, but we started taking the long-distance bus instead. I haven't been here in years."

Chen Guiliang was also observing the railway station. He hadn't been back in many years either.

Revisiting an old place, he felt quite nostalgic.

"We still have to take another ride. Bus or taxi, you choose," Chen Guiliang said.

"I choose a taxi!"

Bian Guanyue answered decisively. She never wanted to ride a bus again in her life.

A line of taxis was parked outside the railway station. Chen Guiliang waved one over, opened the back door, and let Bian Guanyue get in first.

Bian Guanyue glanced at the front passenger seat. She actually wanted to sit there, as she wasn't used to squeezing in the back with others.

After hesitating for a few seconds, Bian Guanyue still got into the back seat, but she pressed her body tightly against the other car door.

Seeing this, Chen Guiliang smiled, closed the back door, and then opened the front passenger door and got in. "Sir, Hongxing Street Department Store."

Bian Guanyue was a little surprised.

She thought Chen Guiliang would take the opportunity to sit with her. Why had he suddenly become such a gentleman?

But back at school, Chen Guiliang would rather skip class just to accompany her to the city to fix her computer. Yet just when she was feeling grateful, he had taken her on a run-down bus and acted like a hooligan the entire time.

All of Chen Guiliang's actions were completely outside Bian Guanyue's expectations.

What kind of person was this?

A few minutes later, they arrived at their destination. Chen Guiliang paid and got out, pointing at the dilapidated department store. "Longdu is pretty backward. There isn't even a single shopping complex, let alone a digital plaza. My cousin went in with someone to rent a storefront here. They build computers and also do computer repairs."

Bian Guanyue had never been here before. She looked around curiously for a few moments, and her first impression was that it was utterly run-down.

This department store was probably several decades old.

The exterior walls were mottled and peeling, and it felt like a chunk of concrete might fall off from somewhere.

The elevator was quite new, though. It must have been installed later.

Taking the elevator to the fourth floor, Chen Guiliang couldn't quite remember the way. After searching for a bit, he finally found his cousin's shop.

"Are you two looking to build a computer?" The only employee in the shop greeted them enthusiastically.

Chen Guiliang called out to the back, "Cousin!"

Feng Tao, who was sitting in front of a computer, heard the voice and looked up, smiling instantly. "Guiliang, what are you doing here?"

"Just came to see you."

Chen Guiliang walked over with a smile. Noticing a technical book on the desk, he couldn't help but tease, "Learning is a lifelong process, eh? You're already a boss and still studying programming."

Feng Tao said, "What kind of boss am I? Just a working stiff."

Chen Guiliang took out a pack of Hongtashan cigarettes, offered one to Feng Tao and the employee, then gestured to Bian Guanyue and said, "My classmate's computer is broken."

The employee had been sneaking glances at Bian Guanyue and didn't even notice the cigarette being offered to him until Feng Tao nudged him.

Without another word, Feng Tao took the computer and began to diagnose the problem.

Finding that the screen remained black, he took out his tools and quickly disassembled it. In less than five minutes, he got the screen to light up. "It's nothing major, the motherboard connector was loose. But your screen is cracked from being dropped, it needs to be replaced. Longdu doesn't have Apple screens, so we'll need to have one shipped from out of town. If you want to save money, I can help you find a second-hand screen, or see if there are any compatible ones."

Bian Guanyue asked, "How long will it take to get a new, genuine screen?"

"Not entirely sure. A half-month at the earliest, maybe forty or fifty days at the latest."

Feng Tao lit the Hongtashan. "Apple parts can only be sourced from Pengcheng. I'll have to check the price, but it's probably between 3,000 and 5,000."

Bian Guanyue felt it was too expensive. "This laptop of mine only cost a little over fifteen thousand when I bought it new."

Chen Guiliang interjected at the right moment, "Cousin, don't you dare rip off my friend."

Feng Tao ignored Chen Guiliang and spoke only to Bian Guanyue. "If you know anyone in Rongcheng, you can call them right now and have them ask a computer repair person there. To be honest, it would be much faster for you to take the bus to Rongcheng to get it fixed than to do it here."

His cousin's meaning was clear; he didn't really want to take this job.

Too much trouble!

And since she was Chen Guiliang's friend, it wouldn't be right to overcharge her.

"Where is the restroom?" Bian Guanyue asked.

Feng Tao said, "Out the door, turn right, and walk all the way to the end."

Bian Guanyue immediately ran to the women's restroom. After relieving herself, she made a call to a classmate in Rongcheng. Her classmate then contacted another classmate, and finally found someone whose family sold computers.

"What model is your Apple laptop?"

"I don't know. It cost over fifteen thousand when I bought it."

"For an Apple laptop in your price range, if you're replacing it with a compatible or second-hand screen, including labor fees for the repair, it would probably cost around one to two thousand yuan. A more ruthless place might charge you two or three thousand. The exact price varies a lot, depending on the quality of the replacement screen."

"What if I want a new screen of the corresponding model?"

"Three to five thousand. If it's not an Apple-authorized repair center, it's very difficult to get genuine parts. Strictly speaking, the contract factories in Pengcheng are also shipping parts out illegally. Those people take risks, so of course they have to make a profit."

"Thanks, I understand now."

Bian Guanyue was no silly, sweet girl. She was very smart, just quiet.

After that one phone call, she knew Chen Guiliang's cousin hadn't been lying to her.

Returning to the shop, Feng Tao asked with a smile, "How about it? I wasn't quoting you a random price, was I?"

Bian Guanyue said, "I'll have it repaired here."

Feng Tao said, "If you trust me, you can leave the laptop here, and I'll call you when it's fixed. If you don't trust me, you can take the laptop back, and I'll contact you when the screen arrives."

"I'll take it back for now," Bian Guanyue said.

Feng Tao added, "If you don't leave the computer, you'll need to pay a two-thousand-yuan deposit. This is in case you change your mind about the repair halfway through. It's not easy for me to get rid of an Apple screen if I'm stuck with it. If you weren't Guiliang's friend, I'd charge you at least three thousand for the deposit!"

Bian Guanyue took out a UnionPay card. "I'll prepay three thousand, but I want a guarantee that it's a new, genuine screen."

"Quite the little rich girl, aren't you," Feng Tao teased. "I'll write 'guaranteed new, genuine screen' on your receipt. When the screen is being replaced, you can bring a knowledgeable friend to supervise."

He swiped the card for payment and wrote out a receipt.

Bian Guanyue also left her phone number so Feng Tao could contact her when the screen arrived.

Chen Guiliang stood to the side, silently memorizing Bian Guanyue's phone number.

Feng Tao looked at his employee. "What are you standing there for? Just staring at the pretty girl? Go make some tea!"

"Oh." The employee hurried off to make tea.

"No need." Bian Guanyue picked up her computer and backpack, ready to leave.

Chen Guiliang said, "Cousin, we'll be going now."

Feng Tao asked Chen Guiliang, "Not staying a bit longer?"

"I'll come find you later," Chen Guiliang said as he accompanied Bian Guanyue downstairs.

After leaving the department store, Bian Guanyue's mood lifted, the previous gloom completely swept away.

Bian Guanyue said, "Thank you."

"As long as you're happy," Chen Guiliang replied with a smile.

Hearing this, Bian Guanyue quickened her pace to walk ahead, a smile blooming on her face, hidden from Chen Guiliang's view.

When they reached the roadside to wait for a ride, Bian Guanyue remembered their earlier journey and quickly reminded him, "Let's not take that road again this time. I almost threw up when it was at its worst."

Chen Guiliang gloated, "I was letting you experience a different side of life."

They flagged down a taxi and took it to the long-distance bus station, this time, of course, taking the smooth provincial highway.

Chen Guiliang only bought one ticket.

"You're not going back to school?" Bian Guanyue asked in surprise.

Chen Guiliang said, "I still have some things to discuss with my cousin."

Chen Guiliang waited with her until she boarded the bus, then stood at a distance and waved goodbye.

As the distance grew, Bian Guanyue, through the bus window, kept looking back at Chen Guiliang until his waving figure completely disappeared.

The seat next to her was empty, and Bian Guanyue felt surprisingly unaccustomed to it.

It was only then that she remembered Chen Guiliang had been paying for all the transportation.

Should she pay him back?

They were friends now, so it seemed unnecessary to be so picky. What if Chen Guiliang felt too awkward to accept it?

But Chen Guiliang seemed to be very tight on money.

Bian Guanyue thought it over and over, agonizing for a long while, and decided to treat Chen Guiliang to a few meals.

Chen Guiliang was indeed broke. At this moment, he was waiting by the roadside for a bus.

He couldn't bring himself to hail a taxi.

Arriving at the department store again, his cousin Feng Tao was already preparing to close up.

"Closing so early?" Chen Guiliang asked.

Feng Tao explained, "Longdu is too small a place. Not many people have the money to build a computer. Tomorrow is Saturday, so business will probably be a bit better. Might as well go home and rest early today."

Chen Guiliang said, "I'm staying at your place tonight."

"Then I'll call your cousin-in-law and ask her to cook a couple of extra dishes," Feng Tao said, pulling out his phone. "What did you come back to see me for?"

Chen Guiliang said, "To talk about a business deal with you."

Back when I was doing business in Taiwan... (Thanks to the big shots Feng Sheng Shui Qi and Ba Dao Le Ge for the Alliance Leader rewards.)
